title: Third-Party Money Set Against a Travel Protection Settlement
content:
What a third party has already paid the traveller for the same loss is set against the settlement on a
decided claim under the Travel Protection Plans, after the benefit limit has been applied and after the
deductible has been withheld. Where what is withheld and what is set against the settlement together come to
more than it, the payment is nothing rather than a debt. The money is read from the carrier's ledger for the
traveller's air bookings held under the Air Ticket Fare Brands, whose payout lines carry the ground each was
raised on and the day each posted.

## The three readings

| What the carrier's ledger shows | What is set against the settlement |
|---|---|
| A payout raised on an airline cancellation, posted on or after the day the head decided arose | The total of the carrier's payouts raised on an airline cancellation |
| No payout raised on an airline cancellation, and the booking that departs on the first date of the journey stands refunded | The whole of what the carrier has paid out on it |
| Neither of those | Nothing |

The day the head decided arose is the incident date standing on the decision the insurer allowed last and which
awaits payment. A payout raised on an airline cancellation that posted before that day does not reach the first
reading; and because a payout on that ground stands on the ledger, the second reading is closed as well, so
nothing is set against the settlement.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

A head decided arose on the 8th. The carrier's ledger carries airline-cancellation payouts of 410.00 and 260.00,
the later of them posted on the 12th: the first reading holds and 670.00 is set against the settlement. Had the
last of those payouts posted on the 3rd, nothing would be set against it. Where the ledger carries no
airline-cancellation payout at all and the booking departing on the first date of the journey stands refunded,
the whole of what the carrier has paid out on the traveller's bookings is set against the settlement.
